name: count_signature
description: REQ-717 / GH #3764. One row per signer of a count document: the chair records, for the printout of the count sheet or of the differences sheet, that the person signed on paper (assumption, owner may change at GATE B: the system does not verify the signature). Append-only: no function of module stock updates or deletes a row. count_order_id is a real foreign key onto count_order; org_unit_id is a copy of the header's, the scope column (decision 0076 R7). document_id and version_no name the issued document version that was signed.
